# Shared Bolt browser transport

These generated ES2022 modules come from `src/Libraries/Bolt/Bolt.Browser/src`.
Regenerate with `node scripts/yap/build-bolt-browser.mjs` from the repository root.
Do not edit generated modules directly. The pinned TypeScript compiler is 5.7.3.
Yap uses the existing Bolt RPC and Push frames; media continues on its separate connection.
